ui_label: Horizontal grid cell with a unstructured grid type and 1 x 1 degree resolution.
description: Reduced latitude-longitude grid with 169 latitude rows regularly spaced at 1 degree from 78S to 90N, 1 degree longitudinal spacing at the equator and progressively fewer points towards the poles. Only sea points are carried: of the 40930 points on the full reduced grid, 29530 sea points remain.
